stem:
Bina fills a number pyramid. Each box is the sum of the two boxes directly below it. The top box is $25$ and the lower-left box touching it is $9$. The lower-right box touching the top is missing.

Which claim correctly finds the missing box?

options.text: The missing box is $25$, copying the top label into the lower-right entry.
The missing box is $16$, because the missing lower box is $25-9$.
The missing box is $34$, because the missing lower box is $25+9$.
The missing box is $9$, matching the lower-left label already printed.

teacher.key_rationale: Top equals sum of the two touching lower boxes, so missing = 25−9 = 16. Adding reverses the pyramid relation; copying 25 or 9 grabs a printed label.
